policy: Desktop package profiles are architecture-specific build contracts, not proof that packages exist, compile, fit in RAM, or boot on hardware. Never mix packages across ABIs. XFCE4 requires a matching X server, graphics/input drivers and a working kernel/userspace.

targets.reason: MIPSel no-MMU/uClinux and 32 MiB class; standard XFCE4/Xorg is not a viable target. A separately ported Slackware-style userspace and tiny native UI are required.
ARMv7 hard-float; validate exact Slackware ARM package availability, Vita display/input drivers and measured memory before enabling in rootfs.
PowerPC64 big-endian; enable only with a verified boot path, usable memory and matching GPU/display/input stack.
x86_64; platform kernel, GPU/display and controller support must be independently validated.
x86_64; platform kernel, GPU/display and controller support must be independently validated.
i686 and 64 MiB RAM; full XFCE4 stack is a high-risk memory target. Require stripped package set and measured boot/idle memory; retain console fallback.
PPC32 big-endian and 88 MiB RAM; full XFCE4 stack is a high-risk memory target. Require a native PPC port and measured boot/idle memory; retain console fallback.
Independent PowerPC32 port; do not reuse Wii kernel or binary assumptions.
AArch64; SoC-specific kernel, GPU/display and controller support must be independently validated.
AArch64; require public platform enablement and a verified graphics/input stack before packaging.

runtime_contract.display_manager: startx via startx-compatible xinit; no display manager by default
runtime_contract.fallback: tty login remains available if X server or XFCE session fails
runtime_contract.controller: Snakey controller bridge starts only after the input device is detected
